definitions.explanation: A person who has advanced knowledge in an academic field; a researcher or academic professional.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{有名|ゆうめい}な{学者|がくしゃ}だ。
{多|おお}くの{学者|がくしゃ}がこの{問題|もんだい}を{研究|けんきゅう}している。
examples.english: Many scholars are researching this problem.

examples.japanese: {学者|がくしゃ}になるのが{夢|ゆめ}だった。
examples.english: My dream was to become a scholar.

notes:
{学者|がくしゃ} refers to a scholar or academic, typically someone who conducts research and has expertise in an academic field.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {学者|がくしゃ}になる (to become a scholar)
- 〜の{学者|がくしゃ} (scholar of ~)
- {若|わか}い{学者|がくしゃ} (young scholar)

COMPOUND WORDS:
- {科学者|かがくしゃ} (scientist)
- {言語学者|げんごがくしゃ} (linguist)
- {歴史学者|れきしがくしゃ} (historian)
- {経済学者|けいざいがくしゃ} (economist)

RELATED WORDS:
- {研究者|けんきゅうしゃ} (researcher)
- {専門家|せんもんか} (expert, specialist)
